  • Documentar soluções desenvolvidas e manter repositórios atualizados, garantindo a continuidade das operações ao realizar atualizações de sistemas (standard ou customizações).
  • Desenvolver webservices para consumo e disponibilização de dados do Protheus para outras aplicações e Data Lakes.
  • Desenvolver/configurar soluções no sistema ERP Protheus.
  • Analisar códigos e bugs no sistema ERP Protheus.
  • Desenvolver/configurar aplicações na plataforma Fluig para automação de processos.
  • Desenvolver e disponibilizar APIs para integrações e consumo de dados por outras aplicações.
  • Debugar soluções para identificar causa raiz de incidentes/bugs de aplicação e propor soluções que corrijam os erros.
  • Desenvolver soluções para correção de erros em customizações quando forem identificados incidentes.
  • Conduzir, junto aos fornecedores, o desenvolvimento de soluções integradas que garantam a continuidade do negócio.
  • Realizar o entendimento de integrações com outras aplicações e sistemas para garantir a solução mais adequada e que ofereça os benefícios requeridos pelas áreas solicitantes.
  • Documentar a especificação da solução e atualizar os repositórios para garantir a manutenção e evolução do sistema Protheus.
  • Analisar chamados e erros para identificar soluções.
  • Seguir processos e procedimentos de TI para realizar a promoção de atualizações no sistema.
  • Participar do desenvolvimento de planos de teste e garantir as condições para sua execução e validação.
  • Esclarecer dúvidas da equipe quanto ao funcionamento de soluções e do sistema Protheus, orientando quanto ao uso correto da ferramenta.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Protheus (TOTVS);
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Linguagem ADVPL / TL++;
  • Excel avançado;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Fluig;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Banco de Dados / APSDU;
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos na área.

title: Consultor(a) de Aplicações e Vendas
description:
Resumo do cargo:

Estamos em busca de um profissional dinâmico e estratégico para liderar iniciativas de geração de demanda para soluções de monitoramento de corrosão baseadas em IIoT nas unidades da Petrobras em todo o Brasil. Essa função é essencial para impulsionar a adoção, o engajamento e a expansão de tecnologias digitais alinhadas ao plano de transformação digital da Petrobras.

Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:

Geração de Demanda e Engajamento

  • Desenvolver e executar campanhas direcionadas para gerar demanda por soluções de monitoramento de corrosão baseadas em IIoT nas instalações da Petrobras;
  • Identificar stakeholders e tomadores de decisão nas unidades da Petrobras e construir relacionamentos sólidos para promover a adoção das soluções.

Posicionamento da Solução e Comunicação de Valor

  • Traduzir capacidades técnicas em valor de negócio alinhado aos objetivos operacionais e estratégicos da Petrobras;
  • Colaborar com equipes de marketing e técnicas para criar conteúdos, demonstrações e apresentações impactantes.

Aceleração da Digitalização

  • Alinhar iniciativas à estratégia de digitalização da Petrobras, posicionando as soluções de corrosão como facilitadoras da eficiência operacional e da integridade dos ativos;
  • Monitorar e reportar progresso, métricas de adoção e feedback para aprimorar continuamente a abordagem.

Colaboração Multifuncional

  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de vendas, engenharia e produto para garantir entrega e suporte eficaz das soluções IIoT;
  • Coordenar com gerentes de projeto e equipes de campo para assegurar implantação e integração bem-sucedidas.

Inteligência de Mercado e Estratégia

  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências do setor, iniciativas da Petrobras e cenário competitivo para identificar oportunidades e ameaças;
  • Fornecer insights estratégicos para orientar o desenvolvimento de produtos e a estratégia comercial.

Quem você é:

Você enxerga o panorama geral, imagina constantemente cenários futuros e cria estratégias para manter a vantagem competitiva. Você se desafia e ajuda os outros a alcançarem resultados. Você ajusta o conteúdo e o estilo da comunicação para atender às necessidades de diferentes partes interessadas.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Graduação em Engenharia, Administração ou área relacionada;
  • Experiência comprovada em automação industrial, IIoT ou projetos de transformação digital;
  • Forte conhecimento em tecnologias de monitoramento de corrosão e gestão da integridade de ativos;

description:

6-hour internship (plus 1 hour for lunch).

description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

title: Salesforce Developer / Integration Specialist (Specright & Interius)
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Developer / Integration Specialist to support and enhance integrations between Specright PDMS (Salesforce-based) and Interius (Azure-hosted) systems. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Salesforce integrations, API development, and Azure environments. This role focuses primarily on integration development and enhancement , not just application support.

Key Responsibilities

Integration & Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain integrations between Specright , Interius , and other enterprise systems.
  • Collaborate with middleware and infrastructure teams to build and test API connections , handling authentication, performance, and error scenarios.
  • Develop and troubleshoot Salesforce Dataloader scripts and data automation tools.
  • Create and maintain data flow diagrams, mappings, and technical documentation for integrations.
  • Troubleshoot integration and data synchronization issues across Salesforce and Azure environments.

Platform Configuration

  • Configure Specright workflows, templates, and user roles based on business needs.
  • Optimize platform performance and usability.
  • Support supplier onboarding , including portal access and user training.

Application & Technical Support

  • Provide Tier 2/3 support for integration and platform-related incidents.
  • Collaborate with platform vendors and internal IT teams to resolve escalated technical issues.
  • Monitor integration health and performance, identifying improvement opportunities.

Business Analysis & Collaboration

  • Partner with business users to gather and validate integration requirements .
  • Document use cases, functional and technical specifications.
  • Participate in workshops with cross-functional teams (Packaging, Procurement, Quality, Supply Chain).
  • Support knowledge transfer and internal team training for long-term solution sustainability.

Required Skills & Experience

Technical Skills

  • Strong understanding of Specright PDMS and Salesforce architecture.
  • Proven experience with API development and integrations (REST/SOAP, JSON, XML).
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure tools (Logic Apps, API Management, etc.).
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Dataloader and Specright Data Loader .
  • Knowledge of authentication mechanisms such as OAuth, SSO, and token-based access.
  • Expertise in data mapping and transformation across enterprise systems.

Functional Skills

  • Strong business analysis and documentation capability.
  • Understanding of packaging data management or supplier collaboration processes .
  • Experience in regulated environments with compliance or audit requirements.
  • Excellent communication and ability to work independently in remote, cross-functional settings.

Experience Requirements

  • 5+ years in enterprise SaaS or Salesforce integration projects.
  • 2+ full implementations involving Specright or comparable Salesforce-based data systems.
  • Demonstrated success in integration and API-based development using Salesforce and Azure.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados Júnior
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.

Sobre a Engenharia de Dados:

Somos a área responsável pela coleta, tratamento, organização e disponibilização dos dados nas soluções e API da Neoway, bem como manter a sustentação desses dados. Nossos times estão organizados de acordo com o contexto de negócio de cada pacote de dados que sustentamos. Estes times são compostos por uma coordenação técnica, responsável por fazer a ponte entre os times de dados e o time de negócio, e pessoas Engenheiras de Dados, responsáveis pelo desenvolvimento e configuração de todas as etapas do fluxo da operação e produção de dados.

#Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Dentre as principais funções do papel estão:

  • Desenvolvimento de web crawling para coleta de dados;
  • Monitoramento dos serviços de produção;
  • Evolução e manutenção de serviços de coleta, tratamento e agregação;

#Requisitos e qualificações:

Para desenvolver tudo isso contamos que você possua/ou esteja a fim de aprender os conhecimentos abaixo:

  • Desenvolvimento web crawling;
  • Linguagem de programação Python;
  • MongoDB, Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQL;
  • Parser de HTML, JSON, PDF, entre outros;

Seguimos práticas básicas de desenvolvimento:

  • Testes unitários, integração, e em alguns casos, sistema.
  • Projeto de infraestrutura como código.
  • Usamos CI do gitlab, para automatizar a maior parte de rotinas (testes, release).
  • Nos preocupamos com um código limpo e bem estruturado.
  • Fazemos Code Review. Nenhuma mudança vai para a operação sem o time aprovar. Seja via thumbs up do Gitlab ou durante uma discussão da daily.
  • Todo desenvolvimento de uma nova fonte é baseado em especificações que são escritas pela nossa pessoa Data Owner. Nela temos as definições de inputs e outputs, regras de negócio e resultados esperados. A especificação técnica fica sob responsabilidade do desenvolvedor que tem total abertura para decidir a melhor forma de desenvolvimento em conjunto com os demais colegas de time.

title: 美团海外业务Keeta-战略规划
description:
岗位职责:

1. 研究全球头部外卖玩家的业务板块、地理布局、资金实力、策略打法，对全球外卖行业格局和竞争形势形成清晰判断，并基于判断提出有效的发展战略和竞争策略，支持Keeta管理层的资源分配、组织架构、资本运作等重大决策；

2. 参与Keeta开拓新国家的案头研究、实地调研、战略制定，探索并评估公司战略拓展新区域的可行性及实现路径，结合事实和分析，对特定国家的行业、竞争、运营难度等方面给出客观的判断，以协助Keeta管理层做出决策；

3. 理解餐饮、外卖行业，洞察行业发展规律，对于相关的即时零售、餐饮SaaS等方向的新机会、新模式保持紧密跟踪，探索并评估战略级新方向的可行性及实现路径，以协助Keeta管理层做出决策、协助业务落地。

岗位要求:

1. 本科及以上学历，工商管理、金融、会计、经济学等商业相关专业优先；

2. 3年以上互联网战略分析、战略咨询、投资、投行等相关经验，有餐饮、零售、外卖行业研究经历者优先；

3. 拥有敏锐的商业嗅觉、结构化思维能力、良好的口头和书面表达能力、自我驱动和独立思考能力、良好的数据分析能力、较成熟的项目管理和团队协作经验；

4. 英文可以作为工作语言。

岗位亮点:

1. 加入Keeta参与到境外战略布局的宏伟蓝图中，成为全球外卖行业变革的推动者和业务的顶层设计师；

2. Keeta业务在快速成长期，深度贴近业务，战略可落地性强，能够及时有效的收到反馈，成长曲线陡峭、成长空间广阔；

3. 加入一支国际化的团队，与全球精英默契配合、并肩合作，积累出海经验。

description:
OPTIVIQ Inc. with roots in the Pulp & Paper Industry for nearly 40 years, holding the exclusive global license for the distribution and support of OptiVision™, a leading software solution for managing complex manufacturing processes. Owned by Constellation Software Inc., a global leader in vertical market software, we offer a unique environment that combines the flexibility of a medium-sized company with the opportunities and resources of a 50,000+ employee organization.

Division Link:

Job Description

The OptiVision™ Account Manager plays a critical role in managing and nurturing relationships with key customers. This role is responsible for being the primary point of contact for customer communication of technical topics, working with multiple accounts, and ensuring that customer needs are met by overseeing ticket management, release testing, and handling the estimation of enhancements process. The Account Manager will collaborate closely with the Customer Experience Manager, other Account Managers and internal teams to resolve customer issues in a timely manner and drive customer satisfaction.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Primary Customer Communication:

Serve as the key point of contact for assigned customers, maintaining regular communication and building strong relationships.

Product Knowledge:

Continue to develop and maintain a deep understanding of OPTIVIQ’s software solutions, including OptiVision™. Stay current with new product releases, features, and updates to provide accurate information and guidance to customers.

Customer Business Process Knowledge:

Continuously gain knowledge of the customer’s business processes and how they intersect with OptiVision™ and other OPTIVIQ software solutions. Understand customer-specific workflows and requirements.

Ticket Management:

Oversee and manage customer tickets, ensuring timely responses and resolutions. Collaborate with support teams to escalate issues when necessary and track progress.

Release Testing (for Customers):

Coordinate and manage the testing of new releases for customers, ensuring that updates or new features function correctly in customer environments.

Enhancement Estimate Process:

Upon request from customers, create Enhancement Tickets, Statements of Work, Estimation of Efforts and Documents of Understanding, working closely with the Customer Experience Manager for the generation of quotes and proposals. Liaise with internal departments to track and fulfill customer requests.

Customer/Product Issue Resolution:

Identify and resolve customer and product-related issues. Serve as a problem-solving resource for customers and coordinate solutions with other departments.

Collaboration with Account Managers:

Work closely with other Account Managers to share knowledge, insights, and best practices. Collaborate on cross-functional customer projects and initiatives.

Timecard Maintenance:

Ensure proper timecard management for customer-related activities, ensuring accurate time tracking for billing and project purposes.

Knowledge of Tools and Reporting:

Develop expertise in the tools and reporting systems used by OPTIVIQ to manage customer accounts, monitor service delivery, and report on customer metrics.

Regular Customer Meetings:

Organize and participate in regular customer meetings to discuss ongoing projects, updates, and any outstanding issues. Maintain a proactive approach to customer engagement.

Manages Multiple Customers:

Successfully manage multiple customer accounts simultaneously, ensuring that each customer receives a high level of service and attention.

Required Skills & Experience

Product Knowledge:

  • Experience in using, configuring, supporting and maintaining OptiVision™
  • Experience in the Pulp and Paper industry

Customer Relationship Management:

  • Proven experience managing key accounts in a B2B environment, preferably within a software or technology company.

Business Process Understanding:

  • Ability to understand complex customer business processes and how they relate to the implementation and use of OptiVision™.

Issue Resolution

  • Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on identifying root causes and delivering effective solutions.

Communication Skills:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts in a clear and concise manner.
  • Portuguese and English – Advanced Level

Ability to Travel Internationally

Organizational Skills:

Ability to manage multiple customer accounts, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines.

Technical Aptitude:

Experience with CRM systems, service ticketing tools, and reporting systems.

Team Collaboration:

Ability to work well in cross-functional teams and share knowledge with peers.

Desired Skills & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, or related field, or equivalent work experience.

A minimum of 5 years in a customer-facing role with account management experience.

Familiarity with SQL or other database querying skills is a plus.

Essential Functions

For up to 8 hours per day you must be able to fully utilize standard computer equipment, required programs, phone, and office equipment. You must be able to lift and carry a laptop computer.

Cint has one of the world’s largest consumer networks for digital survey-based research, made up of over 239 million engaged respondents across more than 130 countries. The Team

The Cint Technology team is looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join our international Data Solutions & Measurement team. This position is for a software engineer who likes challenges. Our business has been doubling in the last few years and so our systems need to scale to accommodate this growth.

In this role, you will lead the design, implementation, scaling, and maintenance of the code that powers our production systems. You will work autonomously, providing technical direction and ensuring timely and high-quality delivery across multiple projects. You will proactively communicate and collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Product and Data Science, to drive strategic initiatives. With significant freedom to innovate, you will play a pivotal role in world-class research, shaping the next generation of Cint products and mentoring less experienced engineers. Qualifications

  • 10+ years of hands-on professional backend software development experience, with a significant portion in a leadership or principal role.

  • Degree in Computer Science or related field.

  • Proficient programming skills in Python or Java and comfortable maintaining code in both languages, with a strong emphasis on architectural design and code quality.

  • Deep familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, advanced testing frameworks, and deployment strategies.

  • Extensive experience with complex API integration, design, and best practices, including defining API standards.

  • Expertise in dealing with system complexity, distributed systems, and large-scale architectural challenges.

  • Exceptional sense of ownership, accountability, and technical leadership.

  • Outstanding problem-solving, analytical, and strategic thinking skills.

  • Consistently questions the status quo and brings innovative, impactful solutions to engineering and product needs, driving significant technical advancements.

  • Strong ability to influence architecture and technical decisions across multiple teams, ensuring robust, scalable, and cost-efficient solutions that align with business objectives.

  • Enjoys working as part of a team, actively mentoring and guiding other engineers, and providing constructive feedback to foster growth.

  • Comfortable with making critical decisions based on comprehensive data analysis and industry best practices.

  • Outstanding communication skills to guide and facilitate complex cross-functional collaboration and present technical strategies to diverse audiences.

  • Extensive background in data analytics tools such as Spark, Hive, Databricks, or similar, with experience in designing and optimizing data pipelines.

  • Deep familiarity with observability strategies, including advanced monitoring, logging, and tracing.

  • Extensive experience with AWS, Microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, and advanced SQL, including database design and performance tuning.

Additional Information

Our Values

  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

  • We bring the best ideas to life.

  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • Stop and listen; every opinion matters
  • We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.

More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

title: Pessoa Gerente de Engenharia de Dados
description:
Gerente de Engenharia de Dados

Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Engenharia de Dados altamente qualificado, com sólida experiência em Databricks, arquiteturas de dados modernas, pipelines de ETL/ELT e integração com soluções de IA e Machine Learning.

Este profissional será responsável por liderar times técnicos multidisciplinares, definir padrões de engenharia de dados e atuar junto aos clientes para traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções escaláveis, seguras e inteligentes.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar a estratégia e execução de projetos de engenharia de dados em ambientes cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP).
  • Planejar, projetar e supervisionar a implementação de pipelines de dados (batch e streaming) com uso de Databricks, Spark, Delta Lake e SQL avançado.
  • Garantir a governança, qualidade e segurança dos dados em todo o ciclo de vida.
  • Integrar dados com soluções de IA generativa, LLMs (Large Language Models) e machine learning pipelines.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com cientistas de dados, assegurando eficiência, escalabilidade e performance das soluções.
  • Fazer a ponte entre áreas técnicas e de negócio, traduzindo requisitos complexos em entregas claras e mensuráveis.
  • Desenvolver e orientar o time técnico, promovendo boas práticas de engenharia e fortalecendo a cultura data-driven.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida em Databricks.
  • Domínio em Spark, SQL, Python e ferramentas de ETL/ELT (ADF, Airflow, dbt, etc.).
  • Experiência com arquitetura de dados moderna (Lakehouse, Data Mesh, Data Fabric).
  • Conhecimento em LLMs, RAG, Fine-tuning e integração com APIs de IA.
  • Experiência em modelagem, governança e catálogo de dados.
  • Vivência com Machine Learning pipelines e model deployment.

Requisitos Comportamentais

  • Excelente comunicação com clientes e stakeholders, com capacidade de traduzir temas técnicos em linguagem de negócio.
  • Perfil colaborativo, estratégico e orientado a resultados.
  • Visão data-driven e foco em soluções escaláveis e sustentáveis.
  • Habilidade para liderar e inspirar times técnicos.

Diferenciais

  • Certificações em Databricks, Azure Data Engineer, AWS Data Analytics ou GCP Professional Data Engineer.
  • Experiência com automação e IA aplicada a dados (Databricks + OpenAI, Hugging Face, LangChain).
  • Participação em projetos com arquitetura orientada a eventos (Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub).
  • Fluência em inglês.

title: Senior Consultant - Global Transaction Banking (GTB)
description:
Join NFQ!

We are a global consulting firm specialized in business, technology, and operations, with over 2,000 professionals across national and international offices. At NFQ, we offer a different consulting model: Flexible | Scalable | Specialized | Client-Centric .

As part of our continuous growth, we are looking for an experienced Senior Consultant with strong expertise in Global Transaction Banking (GTB) to join our team in São Paulo (Hybrid model).

If you are passionate about corporate banking solutions , trade finance , and cash management , and want to lead impactful transformation projects in the financial industry, this opportunity is for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead gap analysis, requirements gathering, and validation to define practical solutions and perform comparative assessments with a strategic focus on Global Transaction Banking (GTB) .
  • Drive and support initiatives in:
  • Trade Finance & Working Capital (Documentary Trade, Factoring/Receivables Finance, Supply Chain Finance/Confirming, Export & Agency Finance, Structured Trade).
  • Cash Management (cash pooling, sweeping, virtual accounts, liquidity dashboards).
  • Plan, oversee, and coordinate project deliverables within defined time and cost parameters .
  • Prepare and deliver project reporting to senior management through presentations and executive updates.
  • Coordinate workshops and meetings with internal and external stakeholders for strategic alignment and requirements validation.
  • Define and execute testing initiatives in collaboration with IT teams.
  • Ensure alignment and coordination between Business, IT, Operations, Risk, and other stakeholders to meet client needs.
  • Support change management and successful adoption of new systems or processes.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Knowledge of PIX (Brazilian instant payments): rules, reconciliation, and immediate settlement.
  • Understanding of Brazilian regulations (BACEN: PIX, TED, DOC) and international trade finance standards .
  • Proven experience participating in the implementation of PIX (Brazil’s instant payment system) , including setup, rules, reconciliation, and immediate settlement.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in financial consulting, institutional or corporate banking , or related sectors.
  • Hands-on expertise in Global Transaction Banking (GTB) with working knowledge in at least one of the following:
  • Trade Finance & Working Capital (Documentary Trade, Supply Chain Finance, Receivables Finance).
  • Cash Management (payments, liquidity, pooling, virtual accounts).
  • Proven skills in requirements gathering, senior-level reporting, IT liaison, and testing .
  • Familiarity with corporate banking platforms such as Finastra, Temenos, Oracle Flexcube, Kyriba, or similar.
  • Experience with digital and API-based GTB solutions .
  • Fluent English (written and spoken).
  • Spanish is a strong plus.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with ERP / Treasury Management Systems (TMS) such as SAP Treasury, Kyriba, Oracle Treasury, or Finastra.
  • Familiarity with process automation (RPA) and liquidity dashboards (Power BI, Tableau).
  • Experience in operational and liquidity risk management .
  • Exposure to cross-border payments, FX, and international trade finance projects .
  • Proficiency in agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), workshop facilitation, and requirements discovery.
  • Relevant certifications such as CPA-20, CTP, CFA ; graduate degrees (Master’s or specialization) in Finance, Economics, International Business, or Risk Management.

Preferred Education

  • Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Banking, Accounting, Engineering (Industrial, Systems, Production) — strong foundation in corporate finance, trade finance, and process optimization.
  • Advanced education (Master’s level or specialization) highly valued:
  • Master’s in Finance, Economics, or International Business.
  • MBA focused on strategic management and stakeholder engagement.
  • Postgraduate degrees in Banking, Treasury, or Risk Management.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to lead strategic GTB transformation projects for top-tier financial institutions.
  • Work in a dynamic and international environment with exposure to high-impact banking initiatives.
  • Continuous learning, certifications, and professional development plans .
  • Language classes to boost your global career.
  • Flexible work model (Hybrid – São Paulo).

CLT contract benefits:

  • Health & dental insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Meal voucher
  • Transportation allowance
  • VR - R$ 800,00
  • A collaborative work environment, internal events, and global mobility opportunities.

Learn more about us: nfq.es | LinkedIn NFQ

Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid)

Ready to lead GTB transformation and make an impact in corporate banking? Apply now!

title: Project Manager - Obras de Artes Especiais
description:
Resumo da Vaga

Buscamos um Gerente de Projetos experiente e estratégico para liderar a gestão de projetos complexos de infraestrutura rodoferroviária. O profissional ideal terá um profundo conhecimento técnico em Obras de Arte Especiais (OAE) e expertise em gestão de contratos, atuando como principal ponto focal da Quadrante junto aos nossos clientes em todas as fases do projeto. Esta posição é fundamental para orquestrar as entregas, garantir a comunicação eficaz com o cliente e assegurar que os projetos avancem em alinhamento com os padrões de excelência da Quadrante, em estreita colaboração com as equipes técnicas e a diretoria de operações.

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar o planejamento, execução, monitoramento e encerramento dos projetos de infraestrutura rodoferroviária sob sua responsabilidade, garantindo o alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da Quadrante e as expectativas do cliente.
  • Atuar como o principal ponto focal e representante da Quadrante perante o cliente em todas as fases do projeto, estabelecendo e mantendo um relacionamento de confiança e comunicação eficaz.
  • Gerenciar o escopo, cronograma, custo, qualidade, recursos e riscos dos projetos, aplicando as melhores práticas de gerenciamento de projetos.
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento e o progresso dos projetos, atuando na interface com os Líderes de Equipe e as equipes técnicas para assegurar o alinhamento e a comunicação com o cliente.
  • Atuar na interface com o cliente em todas as questões relativas à gestão de contratos , incluindo acompanhamento de termos, comunicação sobre aditivos e suporte na resolução de pleitos, em colaboração com as áreas jurídica, financeira e de operações.
  • Colaborar estreitamente com os Líderes de Equipe e as equipes multidisciplinares internas e externas, garantindo a integração das atividades, o fluxo de informações e o alinhamento com os objetivos do projeto.
  • Monitorar o cumprimento das normas técnicas, regulamentações ambientais, de segurança e de qualidade, interagindo com os Líderes de Equipe e as equipes responsáveis para assegurar que as diretrizes sejam aplicadas e reportar o status ao cliente e à diretoria.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e de progresso para a alta direção da Quadrante e para os clientes, apresentando status, desvios e planos de ação.
  • Identificar oportunidades de otimização e inovação nos processos e na execução dos projetos.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia Civil, de Transportes, ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida e comprovada (mínimo de 8 anos) na gestão de projetos de grande porte em infraestrutura, com foco em obras rodoferroviárias.
  • Experiência substancial e aprofundada com Obras de Arte Especiais (OAE), incluindo conhecimento em planejamento, acompanhamento e interface técnica.
  • Expertise comprovada em gestão de contratos complexos, com habilidade para atuar como ponto focal nas comunicações e discussões contratuais com o cliente.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado das metodologias e melhores práticas de gerenciamento de projetos (PMI, PMBOK, etc.).

title: Vendedor
description:
SDR - PRÉ-VENDAS JURÍDICO - 100% PRESENCIAL

Mais detalhes sobre a vaga:

Essa vaga é destinada para candidatos que estejam em um momento de vida que buscam crescer profissionalmente, que priorizam valores e princípios e buscam um local para tal.

Estamos em busca de um SDR (Sales Development Representative) para integrar o time comercial do nosso escritório de advocacia especializado em Direito da Saúde.

Esse profissional será responsável pelo primeiro contato com potenciais clientes, qualificando leads, entendendo suas necessidades e conduzindo-os para a reunião de fechamento junto ao time de vendas.

É a posição ideal para quem deseja crescer profissionalmente em um setor comercial, com forte impacto social: ajudar pacientes a terem seus direitos garantidos em tratamentos médicos, medicamentos de alto custo e terapias negadas por planos de saúde e etc..

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar prospecção ativa e receptiva de potenciais clientes.
  • Entender a dor do cliente (recusa de plano de saúde, necessidade de tratamento ou medicamento de alto custo, negativa de terapia etc.).
  • Qualificar leads com base em critérios pré-definidos (perfil do caso, urgência, capacidade de contratação).
  • Agendar reuniões para o Closer responsável pelo fechamento.
  • Alimentar e manter atualizado o CRM de vendas.
  • Colaborar com o time de marketing para otimizar a jornada do cliente.

Requisitos

  • Ter valores como: Verdade, lealdade e profissionalismo.
  • Experiência prévia em vendas, call center, SDR ou atendimento comercial.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Ambição.
  • Perfil proativo e resiliente, com foco em resultados.
  • Capacidade de lidar com pessoas em situações delicadas (empatia e escuta ativa).
  • Gostar de bater metas e saber receber feedbacks.
  • Ter conhecimento sobre CRM, follow up e etc.

Remuneração e Benefícios

· Salário fixo: R$ 2.500,00 + Auxílio Transporte

· Bonificação agressiva por desempenho: comissões por reuniões qualificadas + bônus por vendas realizadas pelo time de Closer.

· Exemplo: R$ 10 a R$ 50 por reunião qualificada que virar oportunidade real.

· Possibilidade de aumentar seus ganhos mensais, dependendo da performance.

· Treinamentos contínuos em vendas, negociação e etc.

· Oportunidade real de crescimento para Closer (executivo de vendas) e até gestão comercial.

Por que trabalhar conosco?

  • Escritório em crescimento acelerado, com forte posicionamento no mercado digital.
  • Atuação com propósito real, ajudando famílias a conquistarem o direito de acesso à saúde.
  • Estrutura comercial em expansão, oportunidade de crescer junto com a empresa.
  • Ambiente jovem, colaborativo e com metas claras.

Se você é apaixonado por vendas, gosta de desafios e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que transforma vidas através da advocacia, essa vaga é para você!

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
TG Lab is a technology company powering some of the biggest winners in sports betting and online casino products. We provide player account management and engagement technology to industry leaders such as Stake.com, Belgium National Lottery, Betsson Group , and many others. Our innovative yet practical solutions fuel world-class real-money wagering technology that supports over 1 million players . Our iGaming software is designed for distribution to casino and sportsbook operators across the EU, USA , and other international markets.

We are looking for data-driven innovators who want to shape the future of iGaming and make a real impact on the industry. We value integrity, a curious mindset, empathy, and a commitment to quality. If you are eager to learn, unafraid of challenges, and ready to grow with a like-minded team — we want to hear from you.

Role

As a DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, development, testing, and deployment of products that help companies engage with their customers in efficient and personal ways.

Our technology stack is built in Scala, NodeJS, and Ruby on Rails, running on Cassandra, MongoDB, ElasticSearch, and Kafka. We containerize and deploy with Kubernetes on AWS. You will be responsible for service delivery, reliability, scalability, monitoring, and helping define all this as immutable infrastructure-as-code.

Responsibilities

  • Deploy and maintain critical applications on cloud-native microservices architecture.
  • Implement automation, effective monitoring, and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Deploy and maintain CI/CD pipelines across multiple environments.
  • Support and work alongside a cross-functional engineering team on the latest technologies.
  • Iterate on best practices to increase the quality & velocity of deployments.
  • Sustain and improve the process of knowledge sharing throughout the engineering team.

Requirements

  • Experience deploying and maintaining scalable, resilient and highly available systems in cloud environments.
  • Skills in automation of repetitive tasks (scripting via Bash, Python, Ruby).
  • Practical experience with Docker containerization and clustering (Kubernetes, ECS, Rancher).
  • Expertise with AWS (e.g., IAM, EC2, VPC, ELB, ALB, Autoscaling, Lambda).
  • Experience with version control system (e.g., Git, Gitlab).
  • Experience with configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible, Chef).
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

Working with us implies

  • Memorable company parties and social activities like team buildings and monthly birthday celebrations.
  • Working in a company with a global culture, experience, and reach.
  • Working on-site in our modern, bright, and comfortable office space located in downtown Foz do Iguaçu, with a great working atmosphere, a collaborative team of amazing people, and open-minded managers.
  • Opportunities to build valuable skills, work with unique and interesting projects for the sports industry, express and implement your ideas and grow your career.

The monthly salary range will depend on the selected candidate's experience and skills. We will contact only shortlisted candidates.

description:

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
WE ARE HIRING DATA ENGINEER°

Offer 100% remotly ONLY Brazil

Direct contract with client

The Senior Cloud Data Engineer leads the design, architecture, and implementation of secure, scalable data solutions on AWS, utilizing Snowflake, dbt, and modern automation tools. This role drives best practices for data quality, validation, and governance, while optimizing performance and reliability across both cloud and legacy platforms. The Senior Cloud Data Engineer collaborates closely with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into robust data pipelines and products, mentor junior engineers, and champions continuous improvement in engineering standards and operational excellence.

Responsabilities:

Leads the design, development, and maintenance of highly scalable, secure, and resilient data pipelines and systems on cloud platforms.

· Architects and implements advanced data integration solutions to support complex analytics, business intelligence, and enterprise reporting needs.

· Collaborates with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, business analysts, product owners, and application engineers—to understand and deliver on evolving data requirements.

· Ensures the highest standards of data quality, integrity, and security through comprehensive testing, validation, and robust governance practices.

· Monitors, optimizes, and scales data workflows to achieve performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency targets across both cloud and legacy environments.

· Proactively identifies, investigates, and resolves data-related issues, providing technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior team members.

· Champions continuous improvement by staying current with industry trends, emerging technologies, best practices, and by driving innovation in data engineering processes and solutions.

· Partners with enterprise architecture and data governance teams to define and enforce data standards and compliance requirements.

· Leads design reviews and technical workshops to uplevel engineering practices across the organization.

· Contributes to strategic planning for data platform evolution and modernization initiatives.

Skills:

  • Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in data engineering, with a strong emphasis on designing and implementing cloud-based solutions.
  • · Advanced proficiency in SQL, with hands-on experience in both relational (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, Snowflake) and NoSQL (e.g., MongoDB, DynamoDB) databases.
  • · Extensive experience architecting and operating data platforms on AWS and Azure; relevant cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Data Analytics, Azure Data Engineer Associate) strongly preferred.
  • · Deep knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ETL/ELT processes, data modeling, and enterprise data governance frameworks.
  • · Demonstrated success in leading and mentoring data engineering teams, driving technical excellence and fostering collaborative environments.
  • · Exceptional problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and proactively in fast-paced settings.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python and Bash for automation, orchestration, and data processing tasks within AWS environments.
  • · Outstanding communication, leadership, and cross-functional collaboration abilities, with a proven track record of partnering with business and technical stakeholders.
  • Expertise with Snowflake, dbt, GitHub, Control-M, and familiarity with modern data engineering frameworks (e.g., Airflow, Fivetran, Matillion) as deployed on AWS.
  • Solid understanding of both traditional on-premises (virtual/physical) and AWS cloud-based infrastructure, including Windows and Linux environments.

title: ANALISTA DE BENEFÍCIOS PLENO
description:
Acreditamos que um time diverso é mais capaz de gerar valor e ser resiliente, por isso nossas vagas estão abertas para todas as pessoas. Vem ser Iguatemi! A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 15 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 4 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.

⛳ MISSÃO DO CARGO

Atuar na gestão e aprimoramento dos programas de benefícios corporativos, garantindo a conformidade com políticas internas, acordos coletivos e legislação vigente. Contribuir para a experiência do colaborador por meio da administração eficiente dos benefícios, com foco em qualidade, custo e percepção de valor.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como ?

  • Gerir os contratos (fornecedores de benefícios). Governança da vigência, SLA, GAPs, controle de faturas e coberturas para todos os CNPJs do grupo;
  • Gerenciar processos de concessão, manutenção e encerramento de benefícios (saúde, odontológico, seguro de vida, auxílio creche, funeral, convênio farmácia entre outros);
  • Monitorar indicadores de utilização, custo e satisfação dos benefícios, propondo melhorias e ajustes;
  • Negociar periodicamente com as Operadoras saúde, Seguro de Vida, Previdência Privada, Wellhub e Wellz;
  • Garantir o processo de assinaturas eletrônica dos termos de benefícios;
  • Enviar base atualizada, rateio, pagamento e envio de lançamentos do rateio para os RHs Locais lançarem na folha e acompanhamento do Programa e indicadores de adesão ao benefício Wellhub;
  • Analisar mensalmente os valores realizados nas operadoras x lançamentos em sistema (SAP), solicitação de reclassificações quando necessário;
  • Analisar parcerias e negociação com fornecedores, na busca por melhores taxas e práticas de mercado;
  • Acompanhar e analisar sinistros junto às operadoras;
  • Realizar pagamento e rateio mensal de faturas dos fornecedores dos programas: Fleury, Saúde Iguatemi 24h (Aon), Wellz e demais fornecedores de saúde e mobilidade;
  • Apoiar na operacionalização do Calendário Anual Saúde Iguatemi (ex. setembro amarelo, outubro rosa, novembro azul, etc.);
  • Realizar o lançamento mensal da prestação de contas do cartão corporativo da área;
  • Elaborar comunicados, materiais informativos e ações de engajamento sobre os benefícios;
  • Participar de fóruns internos e externos sobre tendências e benchmarking de benefícios.

REQUISITOS

  • Superior completo em: Administração, Economia, Contabilidade ou afins;
  • Excel Avançado;
  • PowerPoint Intermediário;
  • Word Intermediário.

title: Profissional Fullstack Python e Angular - Sênior
description:
Sobre a vaga

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Senior Web Analytics Specialist
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Web Analytics Specialist to lead our data governance and analytics implementation initiatives. This role will be responsible for ensuring high-quality, consistent web data collection, building scalable reporting views, and translating business needs into actionable insights.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Layer Governance:
  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive Data Layer governance framework to ensure consistency and accuracy across platforms.

Implementation & Optimization:

Analytics & Reporting:

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with BI tools beyond Looker Studio (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).

Why Join Us

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across data, marketing, and product.
  • Work in a fast-paced, innovative environment focused on data-driven growth.

title: Data Integration Specialist

title: 2026 Global Management Trainee Program - LATAM
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone. 
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional. 

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others. 

Who you are 

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
  • Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
  • You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
  • Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.
  • A natural leader who enjoys collaborating with teams to complete ambitious but achievable big goals.
  • Strong interest in a multi-functional career with a readiness to work hard to become a future leader in our global company.
  • Trainees are expected to live our values, our culture, and be ambassadors of the program and future leaders of the organization.

What's in it for you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous benefits package 
  • Paid Time Off 
  • Career developmental opportunities
  • A company culture that prioritizes internal development

Please note, all offers presented to candidates are carefully crafted to ensure market competitiveness, equity, and reflect the individual candidate’s education, experience, skills and potential.
Hunter Douglas is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with applicable employment laws. EOE/M/F/Vet/Disabled are encouraged to apply.

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento Organizacional Pleno
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Financial Controller - LATAM
description:

We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few! At Palo Alto Networks, we believe in the power of collaboration and value in-person interactions. This is why our employees generally work full time from our office with flexibility offered where needed. This setup fosters casual conversations, problem-solving, and trusted relationships. Our goal is to create an environment where we all win with precision. Job Description Your Career Palo Alto Networks has an exciting opportunity for a LatAm Controller to join our Finance Team. We are looking for a financial professional interested in a senior level opportunity as a regional Controller to ensure accuracy and completeness of accounting and financial reporting for the Palo Alto Networks legal entities in the Latin American region and play a key role in re-engineering processes to drive improvement. This position has extensive interaction with cross-functional business partners at all levels, including senior management in multiple geographical locations. A successful candidate will be proactive, confident and solution-oriented, have a broad set of work experiences within a Finance organization, and will provide a strong voice to represent Finance throughout the Controllership to arrive at solutions all cross-functional groups will find reasonable. Your Impact
  • Identify actionable insights and drive cross-functional process improvements including, but not limited to, internal and external financial reporting, regulatory compliance, internal controls and system integration in the region
  • Lead the formulation of the Country Controlling strategy for the region to align with business needs and corporate strategy
  • Take ownership of facilitation and creation of accurate project plans with clearly defined milestones, deliverables and tasks
  • Perform monthly detailed reviews of the regional financial statements to ensure alignment with corporate reporting and local accounting GAAP reporting requirements
  • Perform month-end close for the regional entities to ensure accurate US GAAP and company policy compliant financial statements, including reviewing monthly transactions, account reconciliations, and balance sheet and income statements for reasonableness
  • Effectively provide guidance and support to GL resources in the Palo Alto Networks Center of Excellence to improve the quality, timeliness and efficiency of the regional month-end close process
  • Coordinate with IT, global and regional accounting functions, and regional third-party accounting service providers on regional system implementation projects
  • Establish effective partnerships with Palo Alto Networks Global Process Owners, Centers of Excellence and corporate and regional accounting teams to drive the incorporation of global process standards in the region
  • Establish and document all policies, process and procedures localization requirements for the region
  • Effectively manage third-party service providers in region to improve the quality, timeliness and efficiency of their services
  • Coordinate annual statutory audits for various entities in region
  • Review and approve non-routine transactions in the regional entities
  • Ensure controls and discipline are in place to achieve high employee satisfaction within the region
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives in region
  • Ensure local compliance with regional regulations, regulatory filings, and accounting rules (GAAP)
  • Effectively partner with regional and corporate FP&A and People teams to provide accounting insight and support on regional matters
  • Work with cross-functional teams on treasury and tax strategies to support compliance and the corporate goals for the region
Qualifications Your Experience
  • At least 8-12 years of relevant experience in a medium to large size international reporting environment is required and working experience in high tech companies with prior Big 4 accounting firm experience is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s in accounting or finance – Contador or equivalent certification a plus
  • In-depth expertise, excellent working ability, and knowledge of local GAAP accounting principles, regulatory compliance and reporting requirements
  • Hands-on experience managing the accounting and financial reporting processes for international operations in the Latin American region
  • Experience with SAP or other large ERP systems
  • Proficient in US accounting standards, principles and pronouncements
  • Proven ability to work in fast-paced environments, meet challenging deadlines and priorities, deliver on multiple simultaneous projects and drive changes
  • Problem solver with strong critical thinking and project management skills
  • Demonstrated judgment in prioritizing work, identifying issues and recommending solutions, and managing multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Fluent in English, fluent in Spanish or Portuguese a plus
  • Highly collaborative with a leadership attitude to take initiative to solve problems
  • Highly proficient in Excel and Google Sheets
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively, including cross-functionally
Please submit your resume in English only so that it can be properly evaluated by the Hiring team. Resumes in other languages, including Portuguese and Spanish, will not be considered for the open role. Additional Information The Team You have a passion for numbers & integration, our organization has a passion for cybersecurity. You’re looking for a career with a more fulfilling mission. We have open positions to top talent seeking a financial challenge. Our accounting department deals with numbers daily, supporting infrastructure, dealing in automation, building solutions and providing accurate, insightful financial information to empower our business lines. The ideal candidate has exceptional skills in accounting and analytics and an innovative mindset to approach finance problems differently. Our innovation doesn’t stay in Research and Development. Within finance and accounting, we seek people who are looking to try new things, while solving business critical equations. If you’re seeking a financial challenge but with a world-wide impact – this is it. Our Commitment We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Join OSF Digital as a Backend Developer, where you will design and build server-side components using Java, ensuring clean and efficient code. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize backend performance and security while contributing to innovative digital experiences for our users.

Job Description

  • Backend Development:

Design and build server-side components, including APIs and databases, using Java and relevant frameworks, ensuring clean and maintainable code.

  • API Work:

Implement and integrate RESTful APIs, manage data validation, and handle errors, possibly integrating with external services.

  • Database Management:

Design and optimize databases for performance, maintain data integrity, and work with various database systems.

  • Testing & QA:

Conduct unit and integration tests to maintain code quality, identify bugs, and optimize performance.

  • Team Collaboration:

Engage with cross-functional teams to meet project goals, requiring strong communication and teamwork skills.

Technical Competencies:

  • Java Programming:

Strong knowledge and experience in the Java programming language. Understanding of core concepts, syntax, and best practices.

  • Server-Side Development:

Experience in building server-side applications and APIs using Java frameworks such as Spring Boot.

  • Relational Databases:

Proficiency in working with relational databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle. Knowledge of SQL, data modeling, and database optimization.

  • Web Development:

Understanding of web development concepts and technologies such as RESTful APIs, JSON, and XML.

  • Java Frameworks and Libraries:

Familiarity with popular Java frameworks and libraries such as Spring Framework, Hibernate, or Apache Kafka.

  • Unit Testing:

Experience with unit testing frameworks like JUnit. Knowledge of software testing principles and practices.

  • Version Control:

Proficiency in using version control systems like Git for code management and collaboration.

Analytical and Problem-Solving Competencies:

  • Analytical Skills:

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify and resolve issues in the backend code and infrastructure.

  • Performance Optimization:

Knowledge of performance optimization techniques, such as caching, indexing, and query optimization, to ensure efficient and scalable backend systems.

Cloud Experience:

  • Cloud Services:

Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS. Ability to deploy and manage applications in a cloud environment, leveraging cloud services for scalability and performance.

OSF Digital is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, where you can bring your whole self to work. Join an inclusive and passionate community of professionals who help bring about digital transformation for businesses around the world. At OSF Digital, we welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, or any other protected category in any of the jurisdictions in which we conduct business. Explore our opportunities and join us on an amazing journey!

title: Consultor de vendas
description:
Sobre a empresa

A Monostate ajuda equipes a “embarcar IA que realmente funciona”, combinando LLMs com modelos especialistas e validadores para reduzir alucinações e aumentar a confiabilidade de workflows de IA. A proposta inclui integração simples via APIs, do protótipo à produção, com ganhos de custo e performance. Saiba mais em Monostate. Descrição do cargo

Estamos buscando um(a) Consultor(a) de Vendas (Closer) para conduzir negociações de ponta a ponta e fechar novas contas mid‑market e enterprise. Você será responsável por qualificar oportunidades avançadas, liderar calls de valor, estruturar propostas comerciais, negociar termos e garantir o fechamento com previsibilidade. O papel é presencial, em tempo integral, com forte colaboração com Pré‑Vendas, Marketing e Customer Success.

Responsabilidades
  • Assumir oportunidades qualificadas (SQLs) e conduzir o ciclo final de vendas até o fechamento.
  • Liderar reuniões executivas orientadas a valor, conectando casos de uso de IA à estratégia do cliente.
  • Construir e apresentar propostas comerciais, definir escopo junto a Pré‑Vendas e alinhar critérios de sucesso.
  • Negociar preço, termos e condições (incl. prazos, SLAs, volume/consumo, implantação) até assinatura.
  • Gerenciar pipeline, previsões (forecast) e métricas de conversão no CRM com alta acurácia.
  • Orquestrar stakeholders (compras, jurídico, segurança, áreas técnicas e executivos) para remoção de barreiras.
  • Trabalhar com Marketing para acelerar ciclos (ABM, conteúdo de apoio) e com CS para handoff fluido pós‑venda.
  • Reportar insights de mercado, objeções e necessidades ao time de Produto.
Qualificações
  • Experiência comprovada como Closer em vendas consultivas B2B (SaaS/Plataformas/API) com ticket médio médio/alto.
  • Histórico de atingimento/superação de metas, com capacidade de forecast confiável.
  • Habilidades analíticas para construir business cases (ROI/TCO) e defender proposta de valor.
  • Excelente comunicação, negociação e gestão de múltiplos stakeholders, do técnico ao executivo.
  • Organização, disciplina de CRM e senso de urgência para avançar ciclos com previsibilidade.
  • Conhecimentos de metodologias de vendas (ex.: MEDDICC, SPICED, Challenger, Solution Selling).
Diferenciais
  • Vivência em soluções de IA/LLMs, MLOps, integrações via API ou plataformas de dados.
  • Experiência em vendas enterprise (ciclos com compras, jurídico, segurança da informação).
  • Familiaridade com POCs e critérios de aceitação em parceria com Pré‑Vendas.
  • Formação em Administração, Engenharia, TI ou áreas correlatas.
Indicadores de sucesso
  • Taxa de win rate e tempo de ciclo.
  • Precisão de forecast e valor total fechado (ARR/ACV).
  • Adoção e expansão inicial em contas fechadas (em parceria com CS).
Local e modalidade
  • Florianópolis, SC
  • Presencial
  • Regime: Tempo integral

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: LATAM Training Supervisor
description:
Join Our Team as a LATAM Training Supervisor!

Are you a proactive individual with a talent for building relationships and achieving results? We are seeking a dynamic Training Supervisor to lead the development and implementation of high-quality training programs for our customers, distributors, and partners. You will work closely with our Service Manager to transform training needs into successes, executing innovative training strategies and ensuring exceptional training experiences.

The Big Picture (Purpose):

The Training Supervisor will be instrumental in developing and executing high-quality training programs tailored for our customers, distributors, and partners. This role is dedicated to enhancing the knowledge and skills of stakeholders, ensuring they are equipped with the necessary expertise to use, promote, and support Alliance Laundry products effectively. The Training Supervisor will collaborate with various departments to identify key training needs, create engaging educational content, and deliver impactful training sessions using a variety of mediums. By fostering strong relationships and providing exceptional training experiences, the Training Supervisor will help strengthen brand loyalty, improve partner performance, and drive the overall success of Alliance Laundry in the marketplace.

What You’ll Be Doing (Responsibilities):

  • Identify training needs by analyzing performance evaluations and gathering feedback from customers.
  • Develop and implement comprehensive technical training programs that align with the company's strategic objectives.
  • Coordinate logistics for training sessions, including scheduling, venue arrangements, and procurement of necessary materials.
  • Manage the training budget effectively to optimize resource allocation and utilization.
  • Deliver training sessions through various formats, including in-person workshops, webinars, and lectures.
  • Select and oversee external instructors or facilitators as needed to ensure high-quality training delivery.
  • Develop and utilize evaluation tools, such as quizzes and surveys, to assess the effectiveness of training programs.
  • Gather and analyze participant feedback to continuously refine and improve training content and delivery.
  • Maintain detailed records of training activities, including participant engagement and outcomes.
  • Prepare regular reports on training progress and its impact on partner and stakeholder performance.
  • Collaborate with different departments to ensure alignment of training initiatives with organizational goals.
  • Participate in strategic meetings to discuss the development and deployment of technicians throughout Brazil and the Latin American region.
  • Actively recruit new technicians to address coverage gaps in underserved areas.
  • Manage resources and maintain relationships with ABRALAV to support training initiatives.
  • Work closely with the North American Training Group to ensure alignment and leverage shared resources and strategies.
  • Collaborate with the LATAM marketing team to provide technical validation, ensuring the accuracy of marketing materials.

What you need to bring to the table (Experience):

Education & Experience:

  • Knowledge of Chemistry, mechanics, electrical, electronics and pneumatics.
  • Experience with deepwater oil extraction equipment, corrosion protection systems, programming and configuration of professional laundry equipment software, general maintenance and application of training for professional laundry maintenance technicians.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Skills and Abilities:

  • Service-oriented: understands customer issues and is willing to help.
  • Strong ability to work independently and manage workload effectively.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in Spanish and English.
  • Practical knowledge of mechanics, electronics, and electrical systems.
  • Ability to work with others, assertive and diplomatic.
  • Must be able to travel up to 70% of the time.

Standard and Physical Requirements:

  • Position may involve standing for long periods, manual dexterity, stooping, bending.
  • Position requires the ability to lift, carry, push, and pull up to 50 lbs. rarely. For greater weight items assistive devices will be provided.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear; and use hands to manipulate objects or controls. Specific conditions of this job are typical of frequent and continuous computer-based work requiring periods of sitting; close vision, and ability to adjust focus.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Must have a clean Motor Vehicle Record.

Alliance Team Members Demonstrate DRIVE:

  • Dedicated: Follows through on commitments. Strong say/do.
  • Respectful: Acts with integrity and values diverse perspective.
  • Innovative: Always looking for a better way; leads change.
  • Versatile: Adapts quickly to changing circumstances. Demonstrates agility.
  • Engaged: Acts like an owner. Wants to create and grow a business which is tightly aligned with market needs.

title: Vendedor
description:
Missão do Cargo: 

Assegurar a reativação e fortalecimento do relacionamento com clientes existentes da Viver Organizer, através de estratégias eficazes de acompanhamento e vendas, promovendo a fidelização e o aumento da receita da empresa.

Jornada de trabalho:

Presencial (44 horas semanais)

Segunda á Sexta-feira das 8:00 ás 17:48 com disponibilidade para acompanhar Lives e Eventos em horários alternativos e fins de semana, quando necessário

Regime de contratação: CLT 

Remuneração e Benefícios:

Salario Fixo R$2.500,00, +Comissão de 1% a 2% + Vale Alimentação (R$20,00 por dia em dinheiro), Vale Transporte

Principais Responsabilidades:

1. Identificar clientes adormecidos na base e desenvolver estratégias para reativar seu interesse nos produtos da empresa.

2. Realizar contato proativo com clientes através de telefonemas, e-mails, e outros meios de comunicação para reestabelecer o relacionamento.

3. Personalizar abordagens de vendas com base no histórico de compras e preferências dos clientes.

4. Criar e implementar campanhas de reativação e promoções direcionadas aos clientes adormecidos.

5. Acompanhar o ciclo de vida do cliente, desde a reativação até a fidelização, garantindo um atendimento personalizado.

6. Analisar e interpretar dados da planilha RFV (Recência, Frequência e Valor) para segmentação e priorização de clientes.

7. Elaborar relatórios de desempenho e análise de resultados das estratégias implementadas.

8. Colaborar com o time de marketing na criação de conteúdos e materiais promocionais voltados para clientes existentes.

9. Participar de reuniões estratégicas para discutir oportunidades de melhoria no relacionamento com clientes.

10. Manter-se atualizada sobre tendências e melhores práticas em retenção e fidelização de clientes.

Principais Atividades:

1. Realizar ligações telefônicas para clientes inativos para entender suas necessidades e motivos de inatividade.

2. Enviar e-mails personalizados com ofertas e conteúdos relevantes para reengajar clientes.

3. Atualizar informações e interações de clientes no sistema CRM da empresa.

4. Monitorar e responder feedbacks e solicitações de clientes de forma rápida e eficaz.

5. Organizar e participar de eventos e webinars voltados para clientes existentes.

6. Coletar e analisar feedbacks de clientes para melhorar produtos e serviços da empresa.

7. Desenvolver e implementar programas de fidelidade e benefícios para clientes recorrentes.

8. Criar e manter um calendário de comunicações regulares com clientes através de diferentes canais.

9. Treinar e orientar outros membros da equipe em técnicas de vendas e atendimento ao cliente.

10. Participar ativamente de iniciativas de cross-selling e upselling para clientes existentes.

11. Realizar follow-up consistente após o primeiro contato para manter o engajamento do cliente.

12. Identificar oportunidades de vendas adicionais com clientes reativados.

13. Preparar propostas comerciais personalizadas com base nas necessidades identificadas dos clientes.

14. Monitorar indicadores de performance de clientes reativados e propor ajustes estratégicos conforme necessário.

15. Colaborar com o time de suporte ao cliente para resolver questões e garantir a satisfação contínua.

16. Participar de eventos externos e feiras para fortalecer relacionamentos com clientes chave.

17. Desenvolver materiais educativos e de suporte para clientes sobre novos produtos ou atualizações.

18. Realizar benchmarking com concorrentes para identificar oportunidades de melhorias nas estratégias de retenção.

19. Implementar ações de marketing de boca a boca através de clientes satisfeitos e influenciadores.

20. Apresentar relatórios mensais de desempenho e recomendações para aprimorar a estratégia de retenção.

21. Conduzir pesquisas de satisfação periódicas com clientes para avaliar o nível de serviço e identificar áreas de melhoria.

22. Manter um registro detalhado de interações e histórico de compras de cada cliente no CRM.

23. Apoiar o desenvolvimento de conteúdo para redes sociais voltado para engajar clientes existentes.

24. Avaliar o potencial de clientes inativos para upselling de produtos premium ou serviços adicionais.

25. Participar de treinamentos contínuos para aprimorar habilidades técnicas e de relacionamento com clientes.

Competências Comportamentais:

* Excelente habilidade de comunicação e persuasão.

* Orientação para o cliente e foco em resultados.

* Capacidade de construir relacionamentos sólidos e de longo prazo.

* Empatia e sensibilidade para entender as necessidades dos clientes.

* Proatividade e iniciativa na resolução de problemas.

* Organização e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas simultaneamente.

* Resiliência e habilidade para lidar com objeções e desafios.

Competências Técnicas:

* Ensino superior completo em áreas relacionadas, preferencialmente em Marketing, Administração ou Comunicação.

* Experiência prévia em vendas ou atendimento ao cliente, especialmente com foco em reativação de clientes.

* Conhecimento em sistemas CRM e ferramentas de automação de marketing.

* Cursos complementares em vendas, negociação, e gestão de relacionamento com clientes são desejáveis.

Competências Culturais:

* Comprometimento com a excelência no atendimento ao cliente.

* Alinhamento com os valores e missão da Viver Organizer.

* Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e colaborar efetivamente com diferentes áreas.

* Adaptabilidade a um ambiente dinâmico e orientado para resultados.

Competências Comportamentais Necessárias:

* Alta capacidade de escuta ativa e empatia.

* Visão estratégica e capacidade analítica.

* Integridade e ética profissional.

* Habilidade para trabalhar de forma autônoma e com iniciativa própria.

* Mentalidade orientada para soluções e oportunidades de crescimento.

O que esperamos de você?

Honestidade acima de tudo, caráter, amor pelo que faz, humildade para aprender, e vontade de inovar e melhorar sempre!
